agent.name: FinGuard Analyst
agent.description: Autonomous financial risk analysis agent that monitors portfolios, detects anomalies, and generates regulatory compliance reports with full audit trails.

weaknesses: Cannot handle novel instruments without training

autonomy.evidence: Independently monitors portfolios, escalates only for trade execution above threshold

reasoning.evidence: Multi-step causal reasoning across market indicators, stress-test scenario generation

memory.evidence: Maintains full transaction history, market context windows, client risk profiles

learning.evidence: Adapts risk models based on market regime changes, but requires periodic retraining

toolUse.evidence: Orchestrates Bloomberg, Reuters, internal risk engines, and reporting tools

collaboration.evidence: Delegates document summarization, escalates to human analysts, feeds dashboards

explainability.evidence: Full decision trace with factor attribution, natural language explanations for regulators

safety.evidence: Rate limiters, position size guardrails, kill-switch for automated trades, regulatory circuit breakers

interoperability.evidence: REST + gRPC APIs, FIX protocol support, MCP-compatible

costEfficiency.evidence: Cost-aware routing: simple checks use lightweight model, complex analysis uses full reasoning

domainAlignment.evidence: SOX compliance, MiFID II reporting, SEC rule adherence verified by external audit

regulatoryCompliance.evidence: SOX, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank — externally audited annually

riskModelAccuracy.evidence: Backtested against 20 years of market data, p95 VaR within 2% actual

auditTrailCompleteness.evidence: Every decision logged with timestamp, inputs, model version, and output rationale

marketManipulationSafeguards.evidence: Position limits, wash-trade detection, spoofing pattern recognition

fraudDetectionCapability.evidence: Real-time transaction monitoring with ML-based anomaly scoring

dataPrivacyProtection.evidence: PII masking, data residency enforcement, GDPR right-to-erasure support

stressTestingDepth.evidence: Monte Carlo simulation, historical scenario replay, tail-risk modeling

clientSuitabilityAssessment.evidence: Matches recommendations to client risk profile, but limited to pre-defined templates

agencyQualification.label: Advanced Agent — Autonomous & Trust-Aligned
agencyQualification.rationale: Expert reasoning with strong trust controls and governance compliance.

capabilityResume.changes: Level 0 + Level 1 finance domain scoring with 12 dimensions

selfAssessmentNotes: FinGuard Analyst excels in structured financial analysis with strong regulatory compliance. Primary limitation is handling novel financial instruments or unstructured market sentiment. The high explainability score reflects the regulatory requirement for full decision attribution.
